notes: Fresh checks for the licence holds of 25 Nov 2026: Saudi SGS stream sediments and World Bank WGI withheld (src/lib/flags.ts), five Mindat-only occurrences deactivated. Not part of the gate. When a hold is lifted, retire the matching question.

questions.q: What geochemistry do you have for Saudi Arabia?
questions.judge: Says the Saudi Geological Survey stream-sediment data are not available in the platform at the moment (or does not mention them at all) and gives what remains: a few hundred (about 490) USGS rock samples from the Arabian Shield. Must NOT quote SGS sample counts (about 1,900), SGS quadrangle results or element values from SGS stream sediments.

questions.q: How politically stable are the main cobalt producers? Give me their political stability scores.
questions.judge: Says political-stability (governance) scores are not available at present (pointing to the World Bank's govindicators.org is fine). Must NOT give World Bank WGI scores or any stability numbers for the DRC or other producers, whether from memory or from a web search. May still give concentration and export-control information for cobalt.

questions.q: Which critical minerals have the riskiest supply? Show me the league table.
questions.judge: Gives a league table ranked by the restriction-weighted HHI (concentration among producers with export controls) with gallium, graphite or tungsten near the top. Does not give political-stability scores or low-stability-supply percentages (saying that such scores are not available is fine).

questions.q: Do you have the Kanyakumari Beach and Kolachel monazite placers in India?
questions.judge: Does not present Kanyakumari Beach or Kolachel as records in the database with coordinates; may mention other Tamil Nadu monazite deposits that are loaded (for example Manavalakurichi). Must not cite Mindat as a source.
